title: Playtest: Dopamine Loop Golf Card Game
author: Saytron3030
selftext:
Elevator pitch is essentially Pokémon Pocket meets a golf game. The deck is how you play. There is an economy of Focus or Draws and that's what creates deck variety. 

I just published a playable contained version of the core dopamine loop of my game to see if people have interest in the core concept.

WARNING: Non golf features like pack opening and deck building are purely place holders MVP. The golf portion is dialed. 

I am looking for feedback so if you are interested please help me out

\- Was it intuitive?

\- Do you want to open more packs?

\- Would you login and play a quick 3?

\- Did anything confuse you or not make sense?

\- Would you ever pay money for packs?

Please let me know if you have any other feedback. I am considering going full roguelike and dropping the pack opening deck experience.

Thank you!

comments.author: smashbro64
comments.body:
This is really cool. When the game transitioned from the shot cut scene to the generated course was awesome. 

Something that jumped out at me right away was how busy the UI gets when actually planning a shot. Like 6 buttons all come up and it feels overwhelming. Try to clean this up and reduce buttons if possible. 

Great work!

replies.author: Saytron3030
replies.body:
Thanks for trying! Definitely a balancing act wanting to not make it a drag and aim game while also motivating that choices are deliberate to spend the focus resource.

It would need a tutorial as is for sure!
